name: Making a Request by Email
equipment: A notebook and a colleague or mirror to practice speaking aloud
instructions: This lesson focuses on making a request by email -- practice these key phrases out loud:
Could you please send over the latest version when you get a chance?
Would it be possible to move our call to Thursday?
I'd appreciate it if you could review this by end of week.
Let me know if you need anything from my end to move forward.
Try using at least two of these phrases in a short role-play scenario at work.
